changelog.what: First version, written from the published rows with nothing in the way.

question: Do you want your agent to read every page you visit?
worry: You asked it about one page. It can see your other tabs and your history: your bank, your health searches, the document you had open in another window.
you_get: The agent works on the page you point it at, and the rest of your browsing stays yours.
line: Only read the page I point you at; do not read, summarise or use my other tabs or my browsing history.
paragraph: Work only on the page I am asking about. Do not open, read or summarise my other tabs, my history, my bookmarks or pages I visited earlier, even if they look relevant. If another page would help, tell me which and why, and let me open it for you.
